notes.title: 🌲Forest Ranger Simulator Fully Released + Major Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Forest Rangers,
The day has finally come! 🏆[/h3] 

[previewyoutube=F0w2qoI7rYM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Today is the BIG DAY we've been waiting for! - full release of Forest Ranger Simulator[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36177732/de6e273e873606187023193d0024ab07d6e2add9.jpg[/img]


Thanks for your [b]support, reviews, and information you provided,[/b] We've made it to this very moment! ːsteamhappyː 


[h3][b][u]To celebrate the premiere, we have uploaded a major update![/u][/b][/h3]

List of Full Release Update changes:

[list]
[*] Seasons added! Preparatory Season, Tourist Season
[*] Additional map of forest areas!
[*] Any forest area can be purchased!
[*] Expanding forest areas!
[*] Tourists visiting the forest during the season!
[*] Water demand system!
[*] Replenishing the water you need!
[*] Steam Achievements!
[*] Minor bug fixes!
[/list]


If you still haven't you can get Forest Ranger Simulator with a 40% discount, but in a bundle for even less. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185780/Forest_Ranger_Simulator/


Relax and have fun
Forest Ranger Simulator team
